prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Reinterpret the attached ORIGINAL BG3 Hunter's Mark icon as a polished full-bodied tabletop game icon. Keep the original compact proportions, unmistakable skull and downward hunter's mark. The previous attempt with inflated ivory ornamental ribbons and elaborate crossing bone strips was ugly: avoid that entirely. New approach: one compact SOLID flat-front stylized skull, rounded warm off-white forehead, two large dark maroon sockets, small pointed nasal opening and short blunt teeth. Skull should be about two thirds of the composition. The two sweeping original upper curves and their crossing should be suggested as a SINGLE dark red angular crossed marking engraved on the UPPER FOREHEAD, not giant separate horns, antlers or crossing bones. Immediately above forehead place a modest solid deep-red downward arrowhead / chevron, with the short central vertical stroke from the original, clean simple silhouette and clear separation from skull. Retain the BG3 spell's red and pale ivory identity. Strong thick dark burgundy external outline, restrained dark red interior lines, two or three clean drawn shadow tones and broad muted ivory highlights for modest volume. Cohesive robust skull shape with substantial filled areas; not a hollow neon rune, not ornate heraldry, not jewelry, not shiny sculpted bone curls. Clean handsome slightly ominous fantasy game illustration, moderate detail, readable at 48px. No orange/gold accents, no fiery effects, no aura, no spikes, no protruding horns, no glitter, no brush texture, no realistic teeth or anatomy. No text, target circle, badge or background. Center complete icon with comfortable margins on actual transparent square canvas.
